name: environment
description: Manages a DuploCloud AI environment within a workspace.

attributes.name: workspace_id
attributes.description: ID of the workspace that owns this environment (path parameter).

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the environment.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Optional description of the environment.

attributes.name: scope_ids
attributes.description: Scope IDs that link this environment to a cloud provider account.

attributes.name: mode
attributes.description: Resource mode: Create provisions new infrastructure, Import adopts existing infrastructure.

attributes.name: plan_ids
attributes.description: Plan IDs applied to this environment.

attributes.name: provisioner_type
attributes.description: Provisioner type: Cli, IacNativeTf, IacDuploTf, or DirectApiCall.

attributes.name: provisioner_version
attributes.description: Optional provisioner version.

attributes.name: allowed_workspace_ids
attributes.description: Workspace IDs allowed to access this environment in addition to the owner.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current provisioning status.

attributes.name: environment_id
attributes.description: ID of this environment, for reference by dependent resources.

attributes.name: sub_status
attributes.description: Additional status detail.

attributes.name: blocked_reason
attributes.description: Reason the environment is blocked, when applicable.

attributes.name: ever_completed
attributes.description: Whether the environment has ever reached the Complete state.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Whether the environment is active.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Server-assigned version of the environment record.

attributes.name: owner_workspace_id
attributes.description: Workspace that owns the environment.

attributes.name: provisioned_by_helpdesk
attributes.description: Whether the environment was provisioned by the helpdesk.

attributes.name: spec_version
attributes.description: Spec version identifier (UUID).

attributes.name: created_at
attributes.description: Creation timestamp.

attributes.name: updated_at
attributes.description: Last update timestamp.

attributes.name: warnings
attributes.description: Provisioning warnings.

attributes.name: faults
attributes.description: Provisioning faults.

attributes.name: resource_group_count
attributes.description: Number of resource groups provisioned for this environment.
